stories.title: Earth's fiery birth may have created hundreds of oceans' worth of water
summary: Earth's water may have been born in the planet's fiery atmosphere rather than delivered by icy comets or asteroids.
Scientists discovered that rocky pebbles reacting with hydrogen under extreme heat can produce water in minutes, potentially generating hundreds of oceans' worth during Earth's formation.
The findings suggest that water may be a natural part of how rocky planets form, rather than something that must arrive from space.

summary: Japan FA honorary president is hoping a calmer approach that makes fewer unwelcome headlines for Fifa will be welcomed by footballNot many remember Japan’s bid for the 2022 World Cup, when the country finished the race with only two of the final 22 votes.

stories.title: Debutant Saqib Khan takes seven as Pakistan restrict Sri Lanka to slender lead
summary: Debutant fast bowler Saqib Khan produced a remarkable seven-wicket haul as Pakistan restricted Sri Lanka to a slender 12-run first-innings lead on the fourth day of the opening Test at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium on Thursday.

Saqib finished with outstanding figures of seven for 130 in 34 overs, equalling the record for the most wickets by a Pakistani bowler on Test debut and becoming only the fourth player from the country to claim a seven-wicket haul in his first Test innings.
His sustained accuracy and ability to extract assistance from the surface ensured Sri Lanka could not turn their strong position into a commanding first-innings lead.
